purpose: 12-question readiness scorer for prospective Tempo Network validators across 5 dimensions: hardware (CPU/RAM/NVMe), OS/software (Linux x86_64/ARM64 glibc≥2.38, chrony/ntpd, ports 30303/8000/9000), key management (ed25519, on-chain registration), telemetry, and upgrade cadence (7-day SLA). Flags permissioned entry (partners@tempo.xyz required) and unpublished bond/stake/KYC obligations. infrastructure_mandate. iso20022:party-identification profile.
